::: {.book-summary} ## Book Summary Insight Proverbs presents practical wisdom for godly living. The book teaches that the fear of the Lord is the foundation of true wisdom and righteous living. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 1
Proverbs 1:7
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge
### Why This Verse Foundation of Proverbs ### Chapter Insight This chapter introduces the purpose of Proverbs and warns against sinful influences. The key verse establishes reverence for God as the foundation of true knowledge. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 2
Proverbs 2:6
The LORD gives wisdom
### Why This Verse Source of wisdom ### Chapter Insight This chapter encourages the pursuit of wisdom. The key verse emphasizes that wisdom is a gift from the Lord. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 3
Proverbs 3:5
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted verses in the Bible ### Chapter Insight This chapter teaches trust, obedience, and dependence upon God. The key verse calls believers to trust God rather than their own understanding. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 4
Proverbs 4:23
Keep thy heart with all diligence
### Why This Verse Core wisdom principle ### Chapter Insight This chapter urges wholehearted pursuit of wisdom. The key verse emphasizes guarding the heart because it shapes one's life. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 5
Proverbs 5:18
Rejoice with the wife of thy youth
### Why This Verse Marriage fidelity ### Chapter Insight This chapter warns against sexual immorality. The key verse highlights faithfulness within marriage. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 6
Proverbs 6:6
Go to the ant, thou sluggard
### Why This Verse Famous diligence proverb ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses laziness, dishonesty, and adultery. The key verse warns against behaviors that God hates. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 7
Proverbs 7:2
Keep my commandments and live
### Why This Verse Wisdom and protection ### Chapter Insight This chapter vividly warns against temptation and adultery. The key verse demonstrates the destructive consequences of yielding to temptation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 8
Proverbs 8:35
He that finds me finds life
### Why This Verse Wisdom personified ### Chapter Insight This chapter presents wisdom as calling out to humanity. The key verse highlights wisdom's value and its role in creation. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 9
Proverbs 9:10
Fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom
### Why This Verse Repeated foundational theme ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts the invitations of wisdom and folly. The key verse again establishes the fear of the Lord as the beginning of wisdom. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 10
Proverbs 10:12
Love covers all sins
### Why This Verse Frequently quoted proverb ### Chapter Insight This chapter begins Solomon's collection of practical proverbs. The key verse contrasts righteousness and wickedness in daily life. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 11
Proverbs 11:25
The liberal soul shall be made fat
### Why This Verse Generosity principle ### Chapter Insight This chapter emphasizes integrity, generosity, and humility. The key verse highlights the value of honest dealings. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 12
Proverbs 12:1
Whoever loves instruction loves knowledge
### Why This Verse Teachable spirit ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts wisdom and foolishness. The key verse teaches that discipline is essential for growth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 13
Proverbs 13:20
He that walks with wise men shall be wise
### Why This Verse Influence principle ### Chapter Insight This chapter focuses on diligence, speech, and wise relationships. The key verse emphasizes the influence of companions. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 14
Proverbs 14:12
There is a way that seems right unto a man
### Why This Verse One of Proverbs' best-known warnings ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts wise and foolish living. The key verse teaches that reverence for God provides confidence and security. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 15
Proverbs 15:1
A soft answer turns away wrath
### Why This Verse Extremely popular proverb ### Chapter Insight This chapter highlights the power of words and humility. The key verse demonstrates how gentle speech can defuse conflict. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 16
Proverbs 16:3
Commit thy works unto the LORD
### Why This Verse Guidance and planning ### Chapter Insight This chapter emphasizes God's sovereignty over human plans. The key verse teaches believers to entrust their plans to God. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 17
Proverbs 17:17
A friend loves at all times
### Why This Verse Friendship ### Chapter Insight This chapter focuses on relationships and character. The key verse celebrates faithful friendship during adversity. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 18
Proverbs 18:21
Death and life are in the power of the tongue
### Why This Verse Influence of speech ### Chapter Insight This chapter addresses wisdom in speech and relationships. The key verse highlights the power of words to influence life and death. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 19
Proverbs 19:17
He that has pity on the poor lends to the LORD
### Why This Verse Compassion principle ### Chapter Insight This chapter stresses wisdom, compassion, and integrity. The key verse emphasizes God's direction over human plans. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 20
Proverbs 20:1
Wine is a mocker
### Why This Verse Well-known warning ### Chapter Insight This chapter discusses honesty, diligence, and justice. The key verse highlights the value of wise counsel. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 21
Proverbs 21:3
To do justice and judgment
### Why This Verse Righteous living ### Chapter Insight This chapter emphasizes God's control over human affairs. The key verse demonstrates God's sovereignty even over kings. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 22
Proverbs 22:6
Train up a child in the way he should go
### Why This Verse Most cited parenting proverb ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains practical wisdom for family and community life. The key verse emphasizes training children in godly ways. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 23
Proverbs 23:7
As he thinks in his heart, so is he
### Why This Verse Popular wisdom verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter warns against excess, greed, and foolishness. The key verse urges guarding the heart's desires and affections. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 24
Proverbs 24:16
A just man falls seven times and rises again
### Why This Verse Perseverance ### Chapter Insight This chapter praises wisdom and perseverance. The key verse encourages resilience after failure. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 25
Proverbs 25:21
If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread
### Why This Verse Quoted in Romans 12 ### Chapter Insight This chapter contains additional proverbs of Solomon. The key verse teaches self-control and humility. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 26
Proverbs 26:11
As a dog returns to his vomit
### Why This Verse Quoted in 2 Peter ### Chapter Insight This chapter warns against foolishness and laziness. The key verse highlights the danger of meddling in others' disputes. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 27
Proverbs 27:17
Iron sharpens iron
### Why This Verse One of the most quoted Proverbs ### Chapter Insight This chapter emphasizes friendship, humility, and diligence. The key verse highlights the refining influence of godly relationships. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 28
Proverbs 28:1
The righteous are bold as a lion
### Why This Verse Courage ### Chapter Insight This chapter contrasts the righteous and the wicked. The key verse emphasizes confession and forsaking sin. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 29
Proverbs 29:18
Where there is no vision, the people perish
### Why This Verse Widely quoted leadership verse ### Chapter Insight This chapter focuses on leadership and discipline. The key verse stresses the necessity of God's revelation for moral direction. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 30
Proverbs 30:5
Every word of God is pure
### Why This Verse Trustworthiness of Scripture ### Chapter Insight This chapter records the sayings of Agur. The key verse expresses humility before God's wisdom and truth. ::: ::: {.chapter-entry} ## Chapter 31
Proverbs 31:30
Charm is deceitful and beauty is vain
### Why This Verse Virtuous woman passage ### Chapter Insight This chapter concludes with wisdom from King Lemuel and the virtuous woman. The key verse teaches that reverence for God is the highest measure of character. :::
